title: Collections Desk Standard — Clearing a Disconnect Notice and Reconnecting Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
### Conditions

A disconnect notice on an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account is cleared, and an account disconnected for nonpayment is reconnected, only when one of the following holds, as shown by the system records of the same service account:

1. the payments posted from the notice date through the current date, less the returned payments posted in that span, reach the past-due amount stated on the notice; or
2. a payment arrangement on the same service account has been accepted and is active (Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)); or
3. the past-due amount has been transferred as arrears to a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) enrollment of the same service account.

Where the schedule requires a security deposit record for reconnection — all seven schedules do — a reconnection after a nonpayment disconnection additionally requires a Security Deposits record on the same service account in assessed, partially paid or held status. Clearing a notice before disconnection does not carry this deposit condition.

### The reconnect fee

- The former clause that chose the reconnect fee as the remote figure for a remote-disconnect meter and otherwise as the business-hours or after-hours truck figure according to when the reconnect order was placed is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current reconnect fee basis. The reconnect fee figures themselves remain as stated in the schedule of service charges.
- The fee is billed on the next bill, never collected as a condition of reconnection, and is charged once per reconnection.
- Clearing a notice before disconnection carries no fee.
- The reconnect fee is never waived at the service desk.

### Condition table (hypothetical accounts)

| Payments since notice, less returns | Accepted active arrangement | Arrears moved to PrePay Power | Deposit record (assessed, partially paid or held) | Condition for clearing the notice met | Conditions for reconnecting a disconnected account met |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Reach the notice amount | — | — | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Reach the notice amount | — | — | None | Yes | No |
| Short of it | Yes | — | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Short of it | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Short of it | No | No | Yes | No | No |

superseded_clauses: The reconnect fee is reconnect_fee_remote when the meter_type is ami_remote_disconnect; otherwise it is reconnect_fee_truck_business_hours when the reconnect order is placed on a weekday that is not a cooperative holiday between business_hours_start and business_hours_end, and reconnect_fee_after_hours at any other time.
